#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Cross-seed CI forest plot — visual style matched to Fig 6 (domain gamma)."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.size': 3.5,
    'ytick.major.size': 3.5,
})

# ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# (name, pattern, mean_delta, ci_lo, ci_hi, excludes_zero)
families = [
    ('Qwen2.5-14B',  'Collapse',   -15.7,  -24.99, -10.49, True),
    ('Qwen2.5-7B',   'V-recovery', -1.1,   -1.82,  -0.34,  True),
    ('Phi-4 14.7B',  'Immune',     +0.73,  -0.17,  +1.39,  False),
    ('OLMo-2 7B',    'Benefit',    +1.0,   -0.55,  +2.60,  False),
    ('Gemma-2 9B',   'Benefit',    +2.4,   +1.49,  +3.14,  True),
    ('Falcon3-7B',   'Benefit',    +4.1,   +3.91,  +4.19,  True),
]

# ── Color palette (unified across paper) ──────────────────────────────
PALETTE = {
    'Benefit':    '#2e86ab',
    'Immune':     '#6c757d',
    'Collapse':   '#c0392b',
    'V-recovery': '#e67e22',
}

# ── Figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 3.5))

n = len(families)
y_positions = np.arange(n)[::-1]  # top = index 0

# ── Background sections ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# "Harm" section: top 2 rows (Qwen-14B at y=5, Qwen-7B at y=4)
harm_top = y_positions[0] + 0.5     # 5.5
harm_bot = y_positions[1] - 0.5     # 3.5
ax.axhspan(harm_bot, harm_top, color='#c0392b', alpha=0.06, zorder=0)

# "Benefit" section: bottom 3 rows (OLMo-2 at y=2, Gemma-2 at y=1, Falcon3 at y=0)
ben_top = y_positions[3] + 0.5      # 2.5
ben_bot = y_positions[5] - 0.5      # -0.5
ax.axhspan(ben_bot, ben_top, color='#2e86ab', alpha=0.06, zorder=0)

# "Immune" section: middle row (Phi-4 at y=3) — white/neutral, no shading

# ── Zero reference line ──────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.axvline(x=0, color='#444444', linestyle='-', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.5, zorder=1)

# ── Separator line between Immune and Benefit sections ───────────────
ax.axhline(y=2.5, color='#BBBBBB', linewidth=0.6, linestyle='-', zorder=1)

# ── Plot CI bars + markers ───────────────────────────────────────────
xlim_right = 7  # for annotation placement

for i, (name, pattern, mean, ci_lo, ci_hi, sig) in enumerate(families):
    y = y_positions[i]
    col = PALETTE[pattern]

    # CI bar — thick with cap lines
    ax.hlines(y, ci_lo, ci_hi, color=col, linewidth=3, zorder=2, capstyle='round')
    # Cap lines (small vertical ticks at endpoints)
    cap_h = 0.15
    ax.vlines(ci_lo, y - cap_h, y + cap_h, color=col, linewidth=1.5, zorder=2)
    ax.vlines(ci_hi, y - cap_h, y + cap_h, color=col, linewidth=1.5, zorder=2)

    # Marker: filled if significant, open if not
    if sig:
        ax.plot(mean, y, 'o', color=col, markersize=9, zorder=3,
                markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.8)
    else:
        ax.plot(mean, y, 'o', color='white', markersize=9, zorder=3,
                markeredgecolor=col, markeredgewidth=2.0)

    # Right-aligned annotation: mean delta value
    sign = '+' if mean > 0 else ''
    label = f"{sign}{mean:.1f} pp"
    ax.text(xlim_right - 0.3, y, label, va='center', ha='right',
            fontsize=9, color=col, fontweight='medium')

# ── Falcon3 special annotation: n=2 ─────────────────────────────────
falcon_y = y_positions[5]
ax.text(xlim_right - 0.3, falcon_y - 0.35, 'n = 2', va='center', ha='right',
        fontsize=8, color=PALETTE['Benefit'], fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.7)

# ── Section labels inside background bands ───────────────────────────
ax.text(-26.5, harm_top - 0.18, 'Harm', fontsize=10, color='#c0392b',
        fontweight='bold', va='top', ha='left', alpha=0.85)
ax.text(-26.5, ben_top - 0.18, 'Benefit', fontsize=10, color='#2e86ab',
        fontweight='bold', va='top', ha='left', alpha=0.85)

# ── Y-axis labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax.set_yticklabels([f[0] for f in families], fontsize=10.5)

# ── Axis formatting ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.set_xlabel(r'Cross-seed mean $\Delta$acc at $d_{100}$ (pp)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_xlim(-27, xlim_right)
ax.set_ylim(-0.8, n - 0.3)

# No grid
ax.grid(False)

plt.tight_layout()

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_13/projects/contamcal-irt-calibration/figures/paper'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_cross_seed_ci.pdf', format='pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_cross_seed_ci.png', format='png')
plt.close()
print("Done: fig_cross_seed_ci.pdf and fig_cross_seed_ci.png saved.")

    ('Gemma-2 9B',   'Benefit',    +2.4,   +1.49,  +3.14,  True),
    ('Falcon3-7B',   'Benefit',    +4.1,   +3.91,  +4.19,  True),
]

PALETTE = {
    'Benefit':    '#2e86ab',
    'Immune':     '#6c757d',
    'Collapse':   '#c0392b',
    'V-recovery': '#e67e22',
}

# ── Layout ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 3.5))

n = len(families)
y_positions = np.arange(n)[::-1]  # [5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0]

x_left = -27
x_right = 5.5

# ── Background sections ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# "Harm": Qwen-14B (y=5), Qwen-7B (y=4)
ax.axhspan(3.5, 6.1, color='#c0392b', alpha=0.06, zorder=0)
# "Benefit": OLMo-2 (y=2), Gemma-2 (y=1), Falcon3 (y=0)
ax.axhspan(-0.7, 2.5, color='#2e86ab', alpha=0.06, zorder=0)
# Immune (y=3): white/neutral — no shading

# ── Separator lines ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.axhline(y=3.5, color='#BBBBBB', linewidth=0.6, linestyle='-', zorder=1)
ax.axhline(y=2.5, color='#BBBBBB', linewidth=0.6, linestyle='-', zorder=1)

# ── Zero reference line ──────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.axvline(x=0, color='#444444', linestyle='-', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.5, zorder=1)

# ── Plot CI bars + markers ───────────────────────────────────────────
for i, (name, pattern, mean, ci_lo, ci_hi, sig) in enumerate(families):
    y = y_positions[i]
    col = PALETTE[pattern]
    ci_width = ci_hi - ci_lo

    # CI bar
    ax.hlines(y, ci_lo, ci_hi, color=col, linewidth=3, zorder=2, capstyle='butt')

    # Cap lines — adaptive height
    cap_h = 0.15 if ci_width > 2.0 else 0.10
    ax.vlines(ci_lo, y - cap_h, y + cap_h, color=col, linewidth=1.5, zorder=2)
    ax.vlines(ci_hi, y - cap_h, y + cap_h, color=col, linewidth=1.5, zorder=2)

    # Marker: filled = significant, open = non-significant
    if sig:
        ax.plot(mean, y, 'o', color=col, markersize=9, zorder=3,
                markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.8)
    else:
        ax.plot(mean, y, 'o', color='white', markersize=9, zorder=3,
                markeredgecolor=col, markeredgewidth=2.0)

    # Right-aligned annotation
    sign_char = '+' if mean > 0 else ''
    label = f"{sign_char}{mean:.1f} pp"
    ax.annotate(label, xy=(1.03, y), xycoords=('axes fraction', 'data'),
                va='center', ha='left', fontsize=9, color=col, fontweight='medium',
                annotation_clip=False)

# Falcon3 "n = 2" sub-annotation
falcon_y = y_positions[5]
ax.annotate('n = 2', xy=(1.03, falcon_y - 0.40),
            xycoords=('axes fraction', 'data'),
            va='center', ha='left', fontsize=7.5,
            color=PALETTE['Benefit'], fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.55,
            annotation_clip=False)

# ── Section labels ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# "Harm" — top-left of pink band, above first data row
label_x = x_left + 0.8
ax.text(label_x, 5.88, 'Harm', fontsize=10.5, color='#c0392b',
        fontweight='bold', va='top', ha='left', alpha=0.8)
# "Benefit" — top-left of blue band, just below separator
ax.text(label_x, 2.38, 'Benefit', fontsize=10.5, color='#2e86ab',
        fontweight='bold', va='top', ha='left', alpha=0.8)

# ── Y-axis ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax.set_yticklabels([f[0] for f in families], fontsize=10.5)

# ── Axis formatting ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.set_xlabel(r'Cross-seed mean $\Delta$acc at $d_{100}$ (pp)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_xlim(x_left, x_right)
ax.set_ylim(-0.7, 6.1)
ax.grid(False)
ax.set_xticks([-25, -20, -15, -10, -5, 0, 5])

plt.subplots_adjust(right=0.81, top=0.97, bottom=0.15, left=0.18)

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_13/projects/contamcal-irt-calibration/figures/paper'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_cross_seed_ci.pdf', format='pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_cross_seed_ci.png', format='png')
plt.close()
print("Done: fig_cross_seed_ci.pdf and fig_cross_seed_ci.png saved.")
